research_notes: 2026-10-01 research: official frozen and indexed APH biography, full first-person first speech, ECU profile, indexed council agenda and local resignation report. Targeted business and full-time searches did not establish employer-specific hours or a complete dated chronology.

Follow up each hospital/community/industrial payroll employer and exact dates/hours/leave; Nurses@Work legal entity, ten-year boundaries, clients and overlapping clinical/teaching work; confirm personal role and payer in Solomon Islands.

Obtain TAFE appointment records and ECU/Curtin staff profiles. Secondary search results suggest ECU tutoring 2017–21 and Curtin OHS lecturing 2008–11; these remain leads, not primary-established spells. Reconcile these with first-speech sequence and Darlington residence timing.

Resolve training, study and family-care overlaps, any paid PhD work, council workload and 2025 clinical/business cessation or campaign leave. Relative ten-year and four-year durations are not converted into invented endpoints.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: first speech and official qualifications identify Subiaco hospital training; university thesis establishes 2026 award, with interviews from 2017 requiring reconciliation with stated 2019 study commencement. Council announcement quoted contemporaneously settles 28 May 2025 resignation.

Curtin 2008–2011 and ECU 2017–2021 remain secondary leads: Wikipedia links old public professional profile trish-cook-28a36738, but direct 999; renamed trish-cook-mp denied robots and targeted indexes lacked role detail. No authentication or access bypass. Business News visible profile did not supply the claimed oil/gas date interval.

Gov Insights namesake is an administration specialist without matching nursing biography; not attributed. Searches for Nurses@Work legal entity and TAFE appointments did not identify payroll records. Next leads: historical nursing business registry, public academic CV, TAFE annual reports, and paid hospital-training record.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: public professional-profile evidence was sufficient to promote prior leads into bounded but hours-unknown Curtin OHS lecturing (2008–2011), ECU tutoring (2017–2021), and a broad 1996–2011 oil-and-gas/OHS umbrella. Business News corroborates the latter in visible index text. The university spells overlap the umbrella and are not additive. Exact payroll employers/clients, hours, leave and Nurses@Work boundaries remain unresolved; subscription content was not accessed.

Follow-up2026-10-04: New primary ministerial/PM transcripts and Hansard identify nursing work in the NorthStreetMedicalCentre Midland precinct.2026speech clarifies former clinic was next door to urgentcare, preventing wrong service/opening-date attribution. Legal payer, historic control, hours and start/end remain unknown; clinic work saved separately. Targeted Nurses@Work and Solomon Islands searches lack payroll/business endpoints; US namesake nurse/physician records rejected.

Follow-up2026-10-05: Primary ECU profile independently corroborates nursing tutoring content (social determinants of health) and omitted media-training workshops, saved as undated excluded study. Explicitly preserves university/profile qualification conflicts1991vs1996 nursing and2007vs1999–2006OHS; masters provider not implied ECU because APH identifies Curtin. Generic full-time placement passages describe students, staff vacancies describe electorate employees, and US/UK nurses/farmers namesakes rejected. Registry/name queries still yield no attributable Nurses@Work entity or clinical payroll/TAFE dates. Next lead historical nurse-business registry and individual academic/employmentCV; no full-time totals.
